quest.title: Wind-Stirred Ripples
quest.description: You meet a few Ratniki near Piramida...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: O Torchforger who illuminates the darkness on the borderlands, we Lightkeepers pledge here and now...

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki
dialogues.text: "Thus did I foresee — waves crashing on the shore, the night sky devoured by deathly silence..."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki
dialogues.text: "Thus did I declare — whomsoever cradles the flame and keeps it burning unquenched need not descend into that darkness."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki
dialogues.text: "We are the Lightkeepers, who shine the eternal light of hope into the endless snow-swept plains."

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: My fellow companions, our mission this time is to repel the monsters infesting within the Kipumaki Cliff... And investigate the culprit behind this Wild Hunt outbreak.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: We shall set foot on that cliff, which we last approached three years ago, and fight this decisive battle.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I know many of you, like me, have reasons why you must be on this mission.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Keep this in mind — Piramida is behind us! For the living, for our future, we must not take even one step back!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: As our vow thunders, "Our bones and blood we shall use as fuel, we shall make life greater than death..." We shall fulfill our solemn duty as Ratniki!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: To battle!

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki
dialogues.text: Yes, Captain!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's never seen so many Ratniki gathering and heading out before. This must be real serious business...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Their captain seems like a reliable sort.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Yeah! He looks about the same age as {NICKNAME}, but he's got such an imposing presence!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Paimon's still worried. They're going after that special Wild Hunt, right? Will they actually be okay, even with all those people?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's find a way to pitch in.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm! The Wild Hunt's everyone's problem, not just the Lightkeepers'. We can't just leave this be!
Sorry to bother you both....

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there, gramps. Anything we can help you with?
Hmm. This is our first meeting, but I can already tell that you're no ordinary people.

#I happened to hear that a {M#blond}{F#blonde}-haired adventurer named {NICKNAME} and {M#his}{F#her} companion have arrived in Nod-Krai... bringing with them impressive resumes from adventures all over Teyvat...
Would you happen to be those two legends?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon didn't expect to be recognized here... If this keeps up, we'll have to go undercover just to step outside.

choices.text: Don't you like being famous, Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, it's not like that. Paimon's just worried that if we get a commission to deal with bad guys, they'll get tipped off and run away before we even leave the guild!

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: I am Nikita, an ordinary Ratnik who has been stationed in this remote land for years.

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: Pardon my sudden interruption... But in truth, I have a humble request.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh... Could this be related to the Wild Hunt?

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: Indeed, it has a great deal to do with it. I'd like you to help us find a relic called the "Silver Lampwick."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, you've come to the right people! We're really good at finding things! But what does this relic have to do with the Wild Hunt?

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: Hmm... I'm afraid we have to start with the Wild Hunt calamity that swept through this land 500 years ago. Legend has it that an evil beast wielding dark powers made Nod-Krai its hunting ground, tormenting countless living beings.

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: This lasted until the Torchforger defeated it with <color=#00E1FFFF>three sacred relics: the Sword, the Lamp, and the Mirror</color>, and sealed it beneath Kipumaki Cliff. Only then was the calamity quelled.

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: The Silver Lampwick is one of those three sacred relics. It can summon a barrier to defend against the Wild Hunt's attacks.

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: After quelling the calamity, the Torchforger entrusted it to Alia the fae, guardian of the Pillar of Embla.

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: The situation is critical now, and we must rely on the relic's power to pull through. We've sent Ratniki to search for it, but we aren't exactly experts at hunting down items of power.

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: I would be very grateful if you two could help.

choices.text: This involves the Wild Hunt, so I'll gladly pitch in.

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: Good, good! It seems the tales were right. You're no mere great adventurer, but a righteous hero who fights for the good of others.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In other words, we've gotta go to the Pillar of Embla, find the legendary "Silver Lampwick," and bring it back here...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? But isn't the relic being kept by the fae? How are we supposed to find and retrieve it?

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: According to the legend, following the kuuvahki as it guides you upward will lead you to her. She was once an ally of the Torchforger, so I believe she will understand if you explain the situation to her.

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: But if you do obtain the "Silver Lampwick," please give it to Illuga.

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: You've already seen him. He's the young leader of that force, and thus, and the one who needs this relic most right now...

choices.text: I'll be paid for this gig, I presume?

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: Rest assured. Though our strength may have waned, we Lightkeepers never fail to reward those who assist us.

choices.text: Fortunately, I'm used to being famous.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What, have you been practicing your signature in secret or something?

choices.text: How did our whereabouts get leaked again?

dialogues.text: Are you serious? This damn vehicle's stopped moving again!
Come on, Moonwagon, old friend. Couldn't you hold on a little longer?
We're just a little way from Piramida. Once we get there, you can blow a gasket or buy the farm for all I care.
And yet here you are, stopping in the middle of nowhere. And now you expect us to carry you back to town?
*sigh* Everything seems to be going wrong just as we're busiest. You know what? I don't have time to waste with you, my good Rollon. Looks like we'll need to find more helpers.
Oh my, I don't remember putting a call out, and yet here you are! Now, what divine luck has brought you two to my side, dear friends?
You don't look familiar. A newly recruited treasure hunter, perhaps?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hi there! Paimon's name's Paimon, and {M#he}{F#she}'s {NICKNAME}. We're adventurers, just passing by.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You seem to be in trouble... What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Oh! Hello, I'm Anleifr, a Ratnik. So you two are adventurers... I'm afraid you've come to the wrong place.

choices.text: Don't worry, we won't touch anything.

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: That's not exactly what I meant. Well, can't blame you for being new and not knowing... Anyhow, there's been a large-scale Wild Hunt outbreak in the northern Kipumaki Cliff area.

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: There was an incident at the pioneering-age ancient ruins there some years back. We didn't think it'd turn into something so serious...

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: Look north. You see it? That's where these monsters have been swarming in from. If you don't have any urgent business, you'd better not wander around this area, because things are lookin' ugly.

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: How do I know this, you ask? Well, the old man just ordered us back to Piramida to join the operation to eradicate the Wild Hunt.

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: Ain't that so, Rollon?

response.speaker: Anleifr
response.text: Hey, what's wrong with you? You've been quiet for a while now...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, but there isn't much time to show you around. We've got a tough battle ahead, so if you've got preparations to make, best make them quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I'll lead the main force to Cliffwatch Camp first to make the necessary preparations for battle. We'll wait for you to join us there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Got it! We'll be there as soon as possible!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, let's see what we've gotta prep...
Sorry to bother you both....

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there, gramps. Anything we can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: I am Nikita, an ordinary Ratnik who has been stationed in this remote land for years. Though this is our first meeting, I can already tell that you're no ordinary people..

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: #I happened to hear that a blonde-haired adventurer named {NICKNAME} and {M#his}{F#her} companion have arrived in Nod-Krai... bringing with them impressive resumes from adventures all over Teyvat...

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: Would you happen to be those two legends?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon didn't expect to be recognized here... If this keeps up, we'll have to go undercover just to step outside.

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: I see you both attended the oath-swearing. Are you also going to eradicate the monsters at Kipumaki Cliff?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! We're temporary members of the investigation team!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You told Nikita about how you met Illuga and joined the investigation team...

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: I see. That child truly is blessed to have met you both. With your support in this operation, I can rest much easier.

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: I might be saying something unnecessary here, but this is the first time he's captained such a challenging mission.

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: Illuga's no doubt the most outstanding member of the new generation of Ratniki, so I'm not worried about his combat abilities. My only worry is that he...

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: Perhaps that's too much fretting. I've heard a lot about you. You're an old hand at investigating dangerous places like this.

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: Anyway, I hope the knowledge you've gained in your adventures can help him out.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Of course. I am a member of his team, after all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! We'd do our best to help him even if you hadn't asked!

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: That's great. Shame my legs aren't as nimble as they used to be, otherwise I would've gone to Kipumaki Cliff to face that monster myself.

response.speaker: Nikita
response.text: Heh. So this burden had to be left to the younger generation after all...

choices.text: How did our whereabouts get leaked again?

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Rollon, you sure you're okay?

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: I'm fine. Sorry... Let my guard down a bit there. Y'know, what with us returning to Piramida soon and all...

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: I'm just glad you're in one piece. The Wild Hunt might've got you good without this young'un's help... Anyway, thank you both.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Piece of cake for {NICKNAME}, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: You've got some smooth moves. What would you say to joining up with us Lightkeepers?

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: But honestly, inviting you at this juncture might seem like betrayal to outsiders... Never mind, forget what I just said.

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: What we just faced was the Wild Hunt from Kipumaki Cliff. They're an odd lot. Not only do they attack living beings in packs, but word is that they can even manipulate minds...

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Who knows what kind of dark sorcery they wield, but they wait for the moment your will starts to wane, and then they snatch you right up and press-gang you into their service...

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: This operation is meant to defeat them. But if it goes sideways, there might not be any Lightkeepers left to speak of...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I—Is it really that bad?

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Yes, but this isn't for adventurers... especially young ones like you to worry about. Just leave it to us.

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Should we have the chance to meet again, I'll treat you to a swig of Piramida Nightingale and some meat-stuffed rye bread as thanks. Call it good old Lightkeeper hospitality!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll meet again someday for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good luck, and make sure to come back safe and sound!

dialogues.speaker: Anleifr
dialogues.text: Thanks. We'll be heading back to Piramida now. Till next we meet!

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: You know I wouldn't call myself a regular volunteer, but are you certain my aid is not warranted this time?

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: Oh, Flins, you're here. I thought you wouldn't show up.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Would you write me so frequently if you believed that in truth?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Why, by my reckoning, you had a missive delivered to my lighthouse posting a week ago. Do I seem like the sort of Ratnik who would disrespect his Starshyna by not even checking in?

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: No, and in any case, we at HQ have never failed to send you check-in notices either. You have the kid to thank for that. He's the closest to you of us Lightkeepers. Always presses me about how you're doing.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: How fares the young master?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Ah. So you have entrusted him with grave responsibility after all.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: Yes. I need him, and I trust him greatly as well...

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: I believe my warning was clear. This is no ordinary Wild Hunt. Those monsters were drawn here by an ancient being, one that has been sealed in the Kipumaki Cliff for ages.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: I also know a little about "him." We met at the Belyi Tsar's court, even. No garden-variety viper was he.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: I recall those eyes of his. They were exactly like the ones staring at us right now.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: Do you remember how we became Lightkeepers, Flins?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: You mean "you people"?

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: "We," Flins, us. Lately, I've been dreaming about the past, about those battles we went through together.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: Disaster always strikes suddenly... Whether you are ready to fight and face it, or you cling to fear and pray for the best, no one is spared when the time comes.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: However, we know that we must struggle until lasting peace arrives. We Lightkeepers have proved that. We built the foundations of this fortress through five hundred years of struggle.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: True, but I would suggest that Illuga need not attend remedial lessons on this subject yet. You know better than I that he has lost everything once before.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Indeed, only his youthful spirit prevents him from admitting this truth, I deem.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: Yet my time is running out... Little remains of the years I bought for him, especially when compared to the burden he must soon shoulder.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: I see your mind is made up. In that case, let me not waste further breath on persuasion, my good Starshyna.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: By the way, do you remember that item I asked you to look for last time?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: I would never forget a command you gave, sir. A relic from five hundred years ago, and one tied to the first Moonchanter in countless ways. Even I had to go to great lengths to obtain it...

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: Hehe, time for us to prepare as well. Let us witness the power of the bow and arrow bequeathed to us by the Torchforger...

talks.objective: Check on the situation at the plaza
